Name: T's Farm (Type Standard Farm)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Change the farm map for the standard type.

The basic map size remains the same.
A hot spring is added in the upper left corner as a point where water can be supplied to the water can.
If the difficulty level of play becomes too gentle, the entrance to this spa can be blocked from the Mod Config.
